observation: Flag shape appears only mildly curved and lacks the deep rolling waves and trailing-edge snap expected from a strong left-to-right breeze. Hoist-side mounting/orientation also appears visually inconsistent with the requested setup.
expected_behavior: A large Irish flag should billow outward with pronounced cloth deformation under steady strong wind, showing tension near the hoist edge, larger traveling folds across the body, and sharper flutter/compression near the fly edge.
actual_behavior: The render shows a relatively smooth, weakly deformed flag surface that reads closer to a gently bent sheet than wind-driven cloth. The attachment orientation is unclear and the silhouette lacks strong aerodynamic motion.
